summary: ZenaTech, Inc. filed a Form 6-K with press releases announcing the completion of its 26th Drone as a Service acquisition—Dayton, Ohio-based BA Land Professionals LLC, a land surveying firm licensed in four states. This marks ZenaTech's first Ohio location and expands its U.S. footprint to 12 states. Terms (price, structure) were not disclosed. The acquisition is part of a roll-up strategy building a nationwide DaaS network. The filing also notes the 27th acquisition and other operational updates. Watch for continued roll-up execution and integration risks across multiple states.
